summary: Full backend + frontend verification for YuktiCart. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (calculate math for Firstcry double-stack, Tata Cliq not-allowed no-double-stack, /api/detect bean-bag → Furniture/Home, Amazon+Flipkart notice, auth login/me + cookies, unauth 401 on /api/admin/*, platform CRUD + audit, rate matrix import/publish/rollback, gratitude ring/undo idempotency with never-below-zero). Frontend: design selector overlay → Apply Black&Gold enters app; SavingsEngine flow with Firstcry/All/existing/MRP 1599/price 1338 renders ResultsView with ₹88 extra saved, ₹1,251 final bill, ₹349 total saving, CashKaro ₹35 affiliate + Woohoo 7% on ₹750 gift card + ₹588 UPI/card checkout steps. Admin login works with owner creds, /admin dashboard + Platforms/Stores/Categories/Rates/Matrix/Audit sidebar pages all render without errors and audit trail contains platform + import_publish/import_rollback entries. All 12 footer routes render real content (About, Mission, How It Works, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Affiliate Disclosure, Cashback Disclaimer, Cookie Policy, FAQ, Report Rate, Suggest).
action_items: Minor: React dev warning in AdminLogin – 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLogin)'. Likely a navigate() called during render on already-authenticated redirect. Wrap in useEffect. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1151 lines – consider splitting into routers (auth, admin_ref, admin_rates, public) for maintainability.
AdminLogin triggers setState-in-render warning; wrap post-login redirect in useEffect to avoid React 18 concurrent-mode issues.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; TEST_PF_* platforms created and archived within test (restore endpoint returns 200/204/404 – ok). Rate import batches created and rolled back atomically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Use pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; xdist enabled via pytest.ini (2 workers, loadscope). API response shape for /calculate: final_bill lives under summary.final_bill; stacking.double_stack + stacking.gift_card_spend/other_payment_spend; affiliate.best.platform_name; gift_card.best.applied_to. /detect returns category as an object {category, confidence, band}. Import preview requires store_id + platform_id (not raw only).
